expert_yaml:
skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
skill_type: arm

phases:
  - id: arc_over_obstacle
    type: approach
    generator: arc_cartesian
    control: position_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: task_goal
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.18]
      tolerance: 0.02
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
    parameters:
      obstacle_clearance_arc:
        type: scalar
        range: [0.32, 0.44]
        default: 0.38
        binds_to:
          - {path: generator.arc_height, mode: replace}
    guards:
      - id: avoid_obstacle_contact
        when: during_phase
        predicate: force_below
        args: {scope: task_obstacle}
        threshold: 5.0
        on_failure: retry
    retries:
      max_attempts: 1
      strategy: offset_target
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.05]

  - id: descend_to_goal
    type: descend
    generator: linear_cartesian
    control: position_control
    termination: pose_tolerance
    target:
      source: yaml
      anchor: task_goal
      offset: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
      tolerance: 0.02
      orientation: {mode: keep_current}
